> When the clouds gathered, ten times the square root of a flock of swans flew to the Manasa lake, while one-eighth of the flock flew from the water's edge to the forest of lotuses. Three pairs of swans were seen enjoying themselves in the water, which was lovely with young lotus stalks. Tell me the total number of the flock. || 3 ||

**Word Order:** O young woman! When the clouds gathered, ten times the square root of the swan flock went to the Manasa lake. One-eighth of the flock flew from the water's edge to the forest of lotuses. And three pairs of swans were seen indulging in playful activity in the water, beautiful with young lotus stalks. Then tell me the total number of the flock. || 3 ||

**Meaning:** O dear one, aged sixteen! A group of swans existed. Upon the arrival of the rainy season, ten times the square root <gloss>of the total number</gloss> went to Lake Manasa. One-eighth of the flock flew from the edge of the water to a forest of terrestrial lotuses. And three pairs of swans were seen playing with great affection in the water, adorned with soft lotus stalks. Tell me, how many swans were in that flock? || 3 ||

**Setting-out:** Root-multiplier 10. One-eighth 1/8. Visible <gloss>quantity</gloss> 6. Since it is said that the quantity is joined with its remainder, here, by subtracting one part 1/8, we get 7/8. Dividing the visible quantity by this, the visible quantity becomes 48/7. The root-multiplier becomes 80/7. Half the multiplier 40/7. When squared, this becomes 1600/49. Added to the visible quantity 48/7, the sum is 1936/49. Its square root is 44/7. Joined with half the multiplier 40/7, the squared total number of the flock is 144.

**Detailed Working:** According to the rule mentioned in the previous verse, we subtract one-eighth 1/8 from one, resulting in 1/1 - 1/8 = 7/8, or 8-1/8 = 7/8. We divide the visible quantity 6 by this: 6/1 divided by 7/8 = 6/1 × 8/7 = 48/7. By adjusting the seven, this becomes the visible quantity 48/7. Similarly, we divide the root-multiplier 10 by 7/8: 10/1 divided by 7/8 = 10/1 × 8/7 = 80/7. By adjusting the seven, this becomes the root-multiplier 80/7. Now, considering this visible quantity 48/7 and the root-multiplier 80/7, we perform the calculation according to the method mentioned in the previous verse. That is, half of the root-multiplier is 40/7. We square this to get 1600/49. We add this to the visible quantity 48/7...
